text-error.element: Error text on dark surfaces: a light red that stays readable (JetBrains' dark red-100 is used as a base)

icon-over-accent.element: Icons on the accent, such as the selected tool window button: the theme's text-on-accent colour. JetBrains' white was 2.2:1 on Periwinkle Night's lilac and 1.5:1 on Abyss's mint

got-it-bg.element: Onboarding tooltips (Got It, learning tips): the theme's banner colour instead of JetBrains' blue-60

ToolWindow.Button.selectedBackground.element: Selected tool window button on the side strip: stays on the accent with the dark icon, while the dark themes move toolbar-selected-bg-active (which JetBrains uses for both) to a deeper shade for the header-tab pills

List.Tag.foreground.element: Small tags in lists. JetBrains' 868A91 on 393B40 is 3.2:1
